source: https://www.mda.org/care/care-center-list (forward alphabetical list, rows A through 'UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital in Oakland'; designation text 'MDA/ALS Care Center' read from each row) ; https://www.mda.org/care/care-center-list?order=title&sort=desc (reverse-sorted view used to read the designations of rows after 'UCSF Benioff', which the forward page truncated) ; https://www.mda.org/care/mda-care-centers (network map page: full address/phone/link for every listing). State-filtered views https://www.mda.org/near-you/state-XX also confirmed FL, NY, PA, IL and MI.
missing_states_or_notes: All 229 rows of MDA's care center list were reviewed (162 rows on the forward page up to 'UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital in Oakland' plus the 67 remaining rows via the reverse-sorted view and the network map page). Exactly 55 rows carry the designation text 'MDA/ALS Care Center' and all 55 are included; 'MDA Care Center' and 'MDA Care Affiliate' rows are excluded. The 'Gregory W. Fulton ALS Center' row (Phoenix) has no designation label and is the same clinic/address as Barrow Neurological Institute, so it is merged into that item. MDA applies the ALS label at the institution level in several places, so 5 included rows are pediatric/CMT/myotonic sub-clinics (Fairview-Masonic Children's MN, Iowa CMT Clinic, Iowa Myotonic Clinic, Washington University Pediatric MO, West Virginia University Pediatric WV); they are flagged 'Consider excluding' in notes. Several institutions have multiple ALS-labeled rows (Iowa x4, Washington University x3, Fairview/UMN x2, WVU x2). States with at least one MDA/ALS Care Center (27): AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IA, IL, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI, WV. States/territories with MDA Care Centers or Affiliates but NO ALS-designated center: AL, DC, DE, ID, IN, KY, LA, ME, MS, MT, ND, NE, NH, NJ, NM, PR, RI, SC, SD, VA, VT. No MDA listing of any kind was seen for AK, HI, NV or WY. Notable MDA Care Centers (not ALS-designated) that run ALS clinics include University of Virginia Hospital Adult (lists an ALS phone 434-243-5932), Wake Forest, VCU, Duke, Baylor College of Medicine, MUSC and Beth Israel Deaconess. 'Also an ALS Association Certified Treatment Center of Excellence' notes were cross-referenced against the sibling file alsa.json (institution/address match), not against a new als.org fetch. Individual mda.org/clinic/ pages do not display the designation, so the list pages are the sole source of the ALS label.
